messages.author: 6488b93c40082e2c
messages.subject: Loading inla.model in R
parts:
I am trying to use the fitted values from one INLA run for another model. How do i load the results from an earlier INLA run (stored in an inla.model folder) into a fresh R session?

Thanks in advance, 
Anindya

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Loading inla.model in R
parts:
On Sat, 2016-07-09 at 09:24 -0700, anindya basu wrote:
> I am trying to use the fitted values from one INLA run for another
> model. How do i load the results from an earlier INLA run (stored in
> an inla.model folder) into a fresh R session?
>
> Thanks in advance, 
> Anindya

result = inla.collect.results("inla.model")

--

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Loading inla.model in R
parts:
On Mon, 2016-07-11 at 01:10 -0700, anindya basu wrote:
> Thanks for the quick reply Prof. Rue.
>
> On the same note, how to save all the results of a submitted inla
> call into a results folder after the job has finished?

use 'save' to save an R-object, or use

r = inla(..., keep=TRUE)

to keep the results in a local folder (you can change the directory,
with the argument working.directory

H
